2401.05630v1.title: New candidate hypervelocity red clump stars in the inner Galactic bulge

evidence.quote: In total, we found 69 candidate HVSs pointing away from the Galactic centre with transverse velocities larger than the local escape velocity.
65 were detected only in the VIRAC2 sample

values.condition: Equatorial right ascension for ID 46 in the VIRAC2-only red sample (no Gaia DR3 counterpart), as listed in Tables B1/B2.
Equatorial declination for ID 46 in the VIRAC2-only red sample (no Gaia DR3 counterpart), as listed in Tables B1/B2.
Heliocentric distance derived from the red clump photometric calibration for the VIRAC2-only sample (ID 46).
Galactocentric distance r_GC derived from the heliocentric distance and the adopted Galactic-centre parameters for ID 46.
Reported P, the probability of exceeding the escape velocity; Table B2 defines this as the last-column probability for ID 46.

evidence.quote: The last column is the probability of exceeding the escape velocity
